about_the_game:
[Gif 1 - About this game]

Play as Rose and Violet in an exciting twin-stick shooter! Match your shots to enemy colors and battle through prairies, deserts, shimmering caves, and more. Outsmart foes, take down mighty bosses, and reclaim your lost kingdom in this action-packed adventure!

[Gif 2 - Twin stick shooter]

Control both Rose and Violet with a single controller, coordinating your shots using the analog sticks!

[Gif 3 - Meet the dynamic duo]

Join the bravest knights in the flower kingdom on their quest to reclaim liberty!

[Gif 4 - Powerful enemies]

Fight an army of robots, each with their own behavior and moveset!

[Gif 5 - Leaderboard]

Climb your way up to the top in the global leaderboards, clearing all levels in the shortest time possible!

[Gif 6 - Explore a beautiful world]

Witness a variety of environments, helping Rose and Violet through their marvelous journey across the flower world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E8400, 3.0GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+, 3.0GHz or higher
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB or higher
  • DirectX: Version 7.0

short_description: Join Rose and Violet in an epic twin-stick shooter quest! Use their color-coded shots to defeat matching foes as you battle through prairies, deserts, glittering caves, and more. Outsmart enemies, conquer powerful bosses, and restore your kingdom in this vibrant adventure!
